changes: Released 2026-11-27 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).
No scheduled channel restart is installed: the panel's Auto-restart (stream settings, days + time) stays off until you pick days for a channel; the time box only suggests 04:00.

Fixed panel Auto-restart: a change to the days/time only applied after the channel's next restart; it now applies within 5 minutes.
